title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Travel Bulletin: Travel-Abroad Supplement in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards adds a travel-abroad supplement to a quarterly milestone bonus for members who used their Pocketwire Visa Debit Card for foreign purchases over the last twelve months.

## Rule

The milestone travel-abroad supplement is 900 points when the member's debit cards carry at least 4 settled foreign purchases dated within the last twelve months, 350 points when they carry at least 1 but fewer than 4, and nothing when they carry none. The supplement is added to the quarterly milestone bonus credited, in whole points.

The purchases counted are the settled purchase entries marked foreign on the ledgers of the member's Pocketwire Visa Debit Cards. A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Supplement by foreign purchase count

| Settled foreign card purchases within the last twelve months | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 900 points |
| 1, 2 or 3 | 350 points |
| none | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- Three foreign purchases on a physical card and one on a virtual card, all settled within the window: four in all, 900 points.
- One foreign ATM withdrawal and no foreign purchase: an ATM withdrawal is not a purchase; nothing.
